definitions.explanation: An abbreviation of 原子爆弾. Refers to the nuclear fission bombs, especially those dropped on Hiroshima and Nagasaki in 1945.

examples.japanese: {原爆|げんばく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{投下|とうか}→投下：12893_touka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{広島|ひろしま}→広島：28985_hiroshima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{原爆|げんばく}⟦ドーム→ドーム：24058_doomu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れた→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: I visited the Atomic Bomb Dome in Hiroshima.

examples.japanese: {原爆|げんばく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}り{継|つ}ぐ→語り継ぐ：22312_kataritsugu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to pass on stories of the damage caused by the atomic bomb.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {原爆|げんばく}⟦{投下|とうか}→投下：12893_touka⟧ (atomic bomb dropping)
- {原爆|げんばく}⟦ドーム→ドーム：24058_doomu⟧ (Atomic Bomb Dome, in Hiroshima)
- {原爆|げんばく}⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧ / {被爆者|ひばくしゃ} (atomic bomb victim/survivor)
- {原爆|げんばく}⟦{資料館|しりょうかん}→資料館：20143_shiryoukan⟧ (Atomic Bomb Museum)

FORMS:
Abbreviation of ⟦{原子爆弾|げんしばくだん}→原子爆弾：22697_genshibakudan⟧ (atomic bomb). This abbreviated form is the standard way to refer to atomic bombs in Japanese, especially in historical and memorial contexts relating to Hiroshima and Nagasaki.
